findings.claim: appStore values are `import("./x")` expressions evaluated when the object literal is built, so all ~28 app packages still load on first import of @calcom/app-store; the change is async but not lazy, and every caller paid async churn for no load-time gain.
findings.evidence: Language semantics (object-literal initialisers evaluate eagerly); reproduced by three seats with Node scripts where `{a: import('./a'), b: import('./b')}` loads b without b being accessed. Fix: thunks `key: () => import("./x")` and `await appStore[key]?.()` at call sites.
findings.reason: Four-seat agreement plus an executed Node repro; defeats the stated intent of the branch (techdebt/async-app-store-load).

findings.claim: `forEach((ref) => ...)` became `forEach(async (ref) => { await getCalendar(...) })` inside try/catch; getCalendar/CalendarService constructor throws (e.g. undecryptable credential key) now escape the catch as unhandled rejections instead of being logged.
findings.evidence: CalDAV CalendarService constructor runs JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...)) (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts:95) and can throw; `node -e 'try{[1].forEach(async()=>{throw new Error("x")})}catch(e){console.log("caught")}'` never prints caught and exits 1. Fix: `await Promise.all(map(async ...))` or for...of with await inside the try.
findings.reason: Correctness regression reproduced at the language level; SP rated Minor, others Important — normalised to Important because it can crash the process under default --unhandled-rejections=throw.

findings.claim: Same `forEach(async ...)` change as vital/lib/reschedule.ts: getCalendar errors escape the surrounding try/catch as unhandled rejections.
findings.evidence: Identical code to vital/lib/reschedule.ts:124-139; same Node one-liner demonstrates the mechanism.
findings.reason: Same defect, same fix as the vital copy.

findings.claim: requestReschedule now uses `forEach(async ...)` around `await getCalendar`; a getCalendar throw previously failed the mutation before emails/DB updates, now the mutation proceeds and the error is a detached unhandled rejection.
findings.evidence: Same mechanism as the reschedule files; no surrounding try. deleteEvent was already fire-and-forget before the patch; the regression is the synchronous getCalendar failure path. Reasoned, not run.
findings.reason: OCR/SP rated Minor, PT/MP Important; normalised to Important because it changes failure semantics of a user-facing mutation and risks process exit on unhandled rejection.

findings.claim: A failing app-module import now rejects at module evaluation with no handler attached until some request awaits that key, surfacing as an unhandledRejection (process exit under Node defaults) instead of a catchable import error.
findings.evidence: SP Node repro: `{bad: import('./bad.mjs')}` where bad.mjs throws exits with code 1. Whether Next.js installs its own unhandledRejection handler is unverified.
findings.reason: Resolved by the thunk fix for the eager-import finding (no import starts until a key is requested and awaited); no separate change needed.

findings.claim: getCalendarCredentials now stores an un-awaited `Promise<Calendar|null>` in the `calendar` field, including for non-calendar credentials whose result is discarded; a future caller that forgets to await gets a truthy Promise, and discarded promises that reject are unhandled.
findings.evidence: Only reader is getConnectedCalendars (awaits it inside its try); external callers apps/web/pages/api/availability/calendar.ts:83 and packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer.tsx:340,415 pass it straight through. Correct today. Reasoned.
findings.reason: ponytail: correct for all current consumers; revisit when the thunk fix lands (field could hold the thunk or getConnectedCalendars could call getCalendar itself).

findings.claim: Developer docs still instruct adding a static import to packages/app-store/index.ts; the convention is now `appname: import("./appname")`, so contributors following the docs reintroduce the eager pattern.
findings.evidence: Grep of apps/docs for packages/app-store/index.ts hits lines 43 and 56; patch does not touch docs.
findings.reason: Cheap doc update; should describe whichever pattern (thunk) the index.ts fix settles on.

findings.claim: Leftover comment `// example: import("./example")` points at ./example while the folder is _example; dead either way.
findings.evidence: Old comment referenced ./_example; patch changed it.

findings.claim: Diff noise: sylapsvideo moved to the end of the appStore map, and a stray blank line added in getCalendarCredentials (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:31).
findings.evidence: No behavioural change; map order is irrelevant to key lookup.
findings.reason: Cosmetic only; reverting it is its own churn and buys nothing. Advisory Minor, no evidence bar applies.

findings.claim: Old-behaviour branch rewritten from forEach to sequential for...of with await getCalendar, serialising getCalendar calls.
findings.evidence: Raising seat itself notes the rewrite is needed so apiDeletes is populated before it is awaited; PT judged it minimal.
findings.reason: The rewrite is the correct way to await inside the loop (MP's own evidence and PT concur); serial cost is negligible since module loads are already in flight.

findings.claim: No tests added or updated for the changed async contract of getCalendar/getVideoAdapters/appStore lookups.
findings.evidence: No test files in the patch; SP notes no tests exist for these paths before or after.
findings.reason: ponytail: gate not run in benchmark mode; red tests for the accepted fixes would cover the contract — add with the fix round.

findings.claim: CONTRIBUTING requires a full production build and yarn lint to pass; not verified, so TS narrowing on awaited module unions (`"lib" in calendarApp`) is unchecked by the compiler.
findings.evidence: Build/lint/tsc not run per instructions; eslint preset lacks no-floating-promises/no-misused-promises, so lint would not catch the forEach(async) issue anyway.
findings.reason: Gate not run (benchmark mode); settle with `yarn build && yarn lint` (and tsc) in a real run.

findings.claim: Duplicated `paymentApp = await appStore[dirName]; if (!("lib" in ...PaymentService))` block across handleCancelBooking.ts:589, bookings.tsx:967, deletePayment.ts:16, handlePayment.ts:26 — shotgun surgery for a single contract change.
findings.evidence: Pattern predates the PR; the PR only adds await to each copy.
findings.reason: Pre-existing generic code smell outside this change's scope; the override block excludes generic smells.

findings.claim: Pre-existing: `forEach(async ...)` pushes into apiDeletes after an await, so those deletes race the later Promise.all and may never be awaited; the patch adds another await (getCalendar) inside this callback.
findings.evidence: Reported as context by OCR and SP, both stating it predates the patch. Reasoned, not run.
findings.reason: Non-blocking: defect predates the PR (base already had forEach(async) with await before push). Track separately; settle with a test that cancels a booking with multiple references and asserts all calendar deletes complete before the handler returns.
